description: This file defines an internal generic interface IResourceSelector for selecting a subset of resources from a resource list, including a property for resource count and a method for selecting resources without overlap.

classes.name: IResourceSelector<T>
classes.description: An internal interface for selecting resources from a list, with properties and methods for managing resource selection.

methods.name: NextSelection
methods.description: Attempts to select a specified number of resources from the resource list, excluding those already selected.
